title: RxDB changelog entry
description: One change of the next RxDB release. See orga/changelog/README.md

text.description: Markdown text of the change without the leading '- ' and without the links. Must start with one of the change types like FIX, ADD, CHANGE, PERFORMANCE.

links.description: Linked URLs, like the root issue or pull request. They are rendered as markdown links behind the text.

priority.description: How important the change is for RxDB users, from 1 (for example lint fixes or flaky tests) to 10 (for example new plugins). Entries with a higher priority are shown first in the release notes.
